表面应优先呈现玻璃质感，边框、阴影与模糊仅用于强化这一材质选择。
技法
复制技法
渐变边框外壳
Use a thin gradient border shell around the main card. Wrap the surface in an outer shell with 1px padding and a 3px radius. Drive the shell with linear-gradient(to right bottom, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)) so the edge reads like premium depth instead of a flat stroke. Keep the actual stroke understated so the gradient shell remains the hero edge treatment. Inset the real content surface inside the wrapper with a slightly smaller radius so the gradient only appears as a hairline frame.

规范与禁忌
遵循这些约束，可让后续生成保持与当前体系一致，避免漂移到相邻风格。
建议
• 以主色盘作为强调与操作状态的主要点缀色。
• keep spacing aligned to the detected 8px rhythm.
• 在卡片与控件上统一复用玻璃表面处理。
• keep corner radii within the detected 2px, 3px family.
避免
• 除非页面需要新的语义状态，否则不要引入核心色盘角色之外的额外点缀色。
• 不要混用无关的阴影或模糊配方，以免破坏当前深度体系。
• 不要exceed the detected moderate motion intensity without a deliberate reason.
动效
动效克制且以界面为主导，贯穿文字、布局与区块过渡。 时序主要聚集在 300ms 与 150ms。 缓动偏好 Cubic 0.4, 0, 0.2, 1 与 Ease。 悬停行为侧重 Brightness 与 Shadow 变化。 滚动编排采用 GSAP ScrollTrigger 控制区块显现与节奏。

WebGL
WebGL
Reconstruct the graphics as a inset canvas accent using DPR 限制, custom shaders. The effect should read as technical, meditative, and atmospheric: dot-matrix particle field with black and sparse spacing. Build it from dot particles + soft depth fade so the effect reads clearly. Animate it as slow breathing pulse. Interaction can react to the pointer, but only as a subtle drift. Preserve reduced motion + dom fallback.
